name: carbon-aware-analyzer
description: Highlights carbon-inefficient Python patterns and suggests greener alternatives inline.

carbonAnalyzer.executionMode.description: How to run the analyzer. Docker is the normal packaged mode; auto uses local Python when carbon_analyzer.py is present.

carbonAnalyzer.dockerExecutable.description: Docker command used when executionMode is docker or auto selects Docker.

carbonAnalyzer.dockerImage.description: Docker image containing carbon_analyzer.py, grid_advisor.py, aws_dataset.py, and dependencies.

carbonAnalyzer.dynamoDbTable.description: DynamoDB table used for benchmark emissions data. This is passed to the container as DYNAMODB_TABLE.

carbonAnalyzer.awsRegion.description: AWS region for DynamoDB. This is passed to the container as AWS_REGION.

carbonAnalyzer.awsAccessKeyId.description: AWS access key ID for DynamoDB. Leave empty to use AWS credentials from the VS Code process environment.

carbonAnalyzer.awsSecretAccessKey.description: AWS secret access key for DynamoDB. Leave empty to use AWS credentials from the VS Code process environment.

carbonAnalyzer.awsSessionToken.description: Optional AWS session token for temporary credentials.

carbonAnalyzer.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to run the analyzer in local mode.

carbonAnalyzer.analyzerScript.description: Full path to carbon_analyzer.py for local mode. Leave empty to auto-detect from extension folder.

carbonAnalyzer.electricityMapsApiKey.description: ElectricityMaps API key for grid carbon intensity forecasts. Leave empty to disable scheduling advice.

carbonAnalyzer.gridZone.description: ElectricityMaps zone code for your location (e.g. IN-SO for Southern India).
